name: kling
description: Kling AI (official API): text, image and omni video with Kling 4.0/3.0/2.x as polled tasks with downloads, task queries and resource packages

nodes.title: Text to video
nodes.description: Generate a video from a prompt with a Kling model (paid per second; waits for the task and saves the video)

model.description: Model in the path, e.g. kling-4.0, kling-4.0-flash, kling-3.0-turbo, kling-3.0, kling-2.6, kling-2.5-turbo

prompt.description: Scene, characters, actions, camera movement and style

aspect_ratio.description: Frame aspect ratio (21:9, 4:3 and 3:4 only on Kling 4.0 models)

resolution.description: Output resolution (4k only on kling-3.0 models; kling-4.0-flash is 720p only)

audio.description: Native audio for kling-3.0 and kling-2.6 (costs more); Kling 4.0 decides from the prompt

external_task_id.description: Your own unique task id; lets you find the task again with get_tasks

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
